name: closedBall_iSup
statement: Sort*} {p : ι → Seminorm 𝕜 E} (hp : BddAbove (range p)) (e : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : closedBall (⨆ i, p i) e r = ⋂ i, closedBall (p i) e r

name: uniformContinuous_of_continuousAt_zero
statement: Seminorm 𝕝 E} (hp : ContinuousAt p 0) : UniformContinuous p

name: ball_mem_nhds
statement: Seminorm 𝕝 E} (hp : Continuous p) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : p.ball 0 r ∈ (𝓝 0 : Filter E)

name: rescale_to_shell_zpow
statement: Seminorm 𝕜 E) {c : 𝕜} (hc : 1 < ‖c‖) {ε : ℝ} (εpos : 0 < ε) {x : E} (hx : p x ≠ 0) : ∃ n : ℤ, c ^ n ≠ 0 ∧ p (c ^ n • x) < ε ∧ (ε / ‖c‖ ≤ p (c ^ n • x)) ∧ (‖c ^ n‖⁻¹ ≤ ε⁻¹ * ‖c‖ * p x)

name: bound_of_shell_sup
statement: ι → Seminorm 𝕜 E) (s : Finset ι) (q : Seminorm 𝕜 E) {ε : ℝ} {C : ℝ≥0} (ε_pos : 0 < ε) {c : 𝕜} (hc : 1 < ‖c‖) (hf : ∀ x, (∀ i ∈ s, p i x < ε) → ∀ j ∈ s, ε / ‖c‖ ≤ p j x → q x ≤ (C • p j) x) {x : E} (hx : ∃ j, j ∈ s ∧ p j x ≠ 0) : q x ≤ (C • s.sup p) x
